## ICMA 9-17-2026

```{r}
flights |> 
  group_by(month) |> 
  slice_max(dep_delay, n = 2)
```

```{r}
flights |> 
group_by(month)|> summarise(mean_delay = mean (arr_delay, na.rm =TRUE),
                            sd_delay = sd(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE),  
                            number_late = sum(arr_delay > 0, na.rm = TRUE), 
                            total_number = n()) |> 
                  mutate(percentage = number_late/total_number) |> round(2) |> 
                  ggplot(aes(y = percentage, x = month )) + 
                  geom_line() + 
                  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) + 
                  ylim(0,0.55)
```

```{r}
billboard_long_dropna <- billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = wk1:wk76,
               names_to = "week",
               values_to = "rank",
               values_drop_na = TRUE)
billboard_long_dropna |> 
  filter(track == "Baby Don't Cry(Keep..." & week == "wk8")
billboard_long_dropna %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = week,
              values_from = rank)
```

```{r}
billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("wk"),
               names_to = "week",
               names_prefix = "wk",
               values_to = "rank",
               values_drop_na = TRUE)
billboard |> 
  separate(col = date.entered, 
           into = c("year","month","day"),            sep = ","
           ) |> 
  unite(col = date_entered,
        year:day,
        sep = ",", 
        remove = TRUE
        )

```

## ICMA 10-8-2026
ICMA question: what's the difference between these two code chunks? Are the outputs the same?
\\ The difference is the command mapping command used in the first chunk that is absent in the second chunk. The outputs are the same. 
```{r}
mpg |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(y = hwy, x = displ, color = manufacturer)) + 
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ, color = manufacturer)) + 
  geom_point()
```


ICMA question: what are these warnings about and why should we worry about them?
**Answer**:These warnings are referring to the fact that in the shape palette you can only use 6 discrete values. This is a concern because if there are more than 6 data points there may be an error stating missing data if there are more then 6 data points and you are using shapes to represent them. Missing data could cause the graph to not be representative of the findings and the data at large. 

```{r}
mpg |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = hwy, x = displ, shape = manufacturer)) + 
  geom_point()
#shows the the warning about the limit of 6 discrete values 
```


Change the color of the line to something other than the default blue

```{r}
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = class)) + 
  geom_smooth(color='aquamarine')
#changed color of the line to 'aquamarine' 
```
